query:
SELECT aei.email
            FROM auth_email_identities aei
            JOIN users u ON u.id = aei.user_id
            WHERE u.id = $1
              AND (
                  (u.deleted_at IS NULL AND aei.deleted_at IS NULL)
                  OR (
                      u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
                      AND aei.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
                      AND aei.deletion_source = $2
                  )
              )
